messages:
rachael: quick follow-up from today's all-hands — capturing a few hiring/structure Qs that came up in the live Q&A. putting answers here so managers and ICs have one place to check.
dena: thx! first one: SRE hiring — are we prioritizing new headcount or internal moves to cover infra gaps?
rachael: priority is to fill critical SLO-facing roles. internal transfers preferred for knowledge continuity; new hires approved if there's no internal match within 10 business days.
pavel: can you clarify approval thresholds? which level signs off on external hires when a transfer is possible?
lina: for external hires: Manager + People Ops sign-off for normal requests; if it's a net-new FTE or cross-org budget move, Finance approval required. Executive approval only for senior ICs or managers (L5+).
kayla: we have several interns converting next month — do conversions count as new headcount against the freeze?
rachael: intern-to-full conversions do not count against the freeze if conversion was in the pipeline before the announcement. recruiters should tag conversions as `pre-announcement` in Greenhouse.
matt: small ops ask: who owns the risk matrix for deciding which teams can lend people vs which must be fully staffed?
rachael: EngOps + the receiving manager co-own the risk assessment; we'll publish a lightweight risk matrix (customer impact, on-call exposure, upcoming launches). People Ops will host a 30-min office hour to walk managers through it.
dena: about interviewing panels — will panel membership change when someone moves org mid-process? we've got candidates mid-cycle.
lina: panels remain the same for the currently open req. if a panel member transfers before the offer, please replace them and note it on the candidate's file. recruiters will handle reassignments.
pavel: can we get a template for the 1:1 to run with transferred ICs? managers want consistent messaging.
lina: yes — Manager Talking Points + an IC FAQ will be posted today. it covers why transfers happen, impact on promotions, comp, and who to contact about role-fit.
kayla: question on manager budgets: if my headcount moves to another product, how fast can I request a temp contractor as a bridge?
matt: Finance fast-track for contractor bridge: 48hrs for priority buckets, 5 business days for standard. tag requests `bridge-contractor` in the finance portal and cc your EngOps partner.
dena: will people be notified before public org announcements? managers asking for lead time.
lina: standard practice: affected individuals + their managers get notification 48hrs before org-wide post. exceptions for sensitive cases handled by People Ops.
rachael: small note on metrics: we'll publish a short wave readout after wave-1 with headcount moved, offers impacted, contractor fast-tracks, and any customer incidents.
hr-bot: doc-publish: "people-ops/hiring-freeze-exceptions.md" at 2487654365
pavel: can we have a single channel for hiring exceptions to reduce DMs?
rachael: yes — creating #people-ops-hiring-exceptions now. use it + the exception form.
lina: additionally, we'll enable a `transfer-ok` boolean flag in Greenhouse for internal matches — recruiters, please use it when you've vetted a candidate for transfer-fit.
kayla: last tiny ask: will promotion calibration change because of org moves? some folks worried about losing visibility.
rachael: calibration process stays the same. People Ops will ensure transferred ICs are included in calibration pools and maintain their promotion timelines. reach out if you have a borderline case.
rachael: thanks all. posting links and templates here when live. manager office hours tomorrow 2pm PT for quick Qs. :sparkles:
__notes: All-hands follow-up thread: hiring allocation for SRE, intern conversions, approval thresholds, risk matrix for lending headcount, interview panel continuity, manager talking points, contractor bridge SLAs, notification cadence, wave readout metrics, Greenhouse flags, and a new exceptions channel. Slack-style short messages with a bot doc-publish note.
